news.body: An investment vehicle linked to the GMR Group's founding family acquired an additional 3.40% stake in GMR Airports Limited (NSEI:GMRAIRPORT) from Aeroports de Paris SA (ENXTPA:ADP) for approximately €260 million on April 24, 2026. A cash consideration of €256 million will be paid by the buyer. As part of consideration, €256 million is paid towards common equity of GMR Airports Limited. Concurrently, GMR Group has been granted call options, while Groupe ADP retains corresponding put options, for securities representing 3.9% of GAL’s ordinary equity shares for an estimated €285 million. Any transfer arising from the exercise of these options is scheduled to be completed no later than April 30, 2027. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.12 (vs ₹0.25 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.12 (down from ₹0.25 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹40.8b (up 54% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹1.22b (down 54% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 3.0% (down from 10% in 3Q 2025). Revenue is forecast to grow 15% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 6.9% growth forecast for the Infrastructure industry in Asia. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 6% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 33% per year, which means it is well ahead of earnings.
